IF YOU EVER FORGET... 🤍

Read this on the days
you need a reminder.

Jay,

There are so many tiny things about you that I don't want time to make ordinary. Your smile. Your silly expressions. The way you can turn a completely normal day into a memory I want to keep.

I love that our story isn't made only of big, perfect moments. It's made of hands held in crowded places, sleepy faces, ridiculous photos, random outings, little jokes, and the quiet comfort of knowing you're there.

If you ever wonder whether those moments mattered: they did. They matter to me because they are ours.

And if I got to start the story all over again, I would still want to find you somewhere in it.

Always,
Your girl ♡
